title: 第19章 远古犀牛第20章 大爆犀牛
slug: 永恒降临全民开局末世求生
content_zh:
将一些用不上的东西放到二楼的房间中，顺带和苏婷说一声，让她找点水，将之前与大鼠战斗的血迹冲洗掉，一天过去，已经有些味道了。
来到科学二本旁，在[制作-工具]苏婷解锁了一个空浇水壶。
【你消耗木板×2、草绳×1，制作空浇水壶，已解锁空浇水壶，精神值+15。
小小的一个水壶足可以装40升的水，只需要在池塘或者一些水源旁，采集1分钟，一次就可以装好25%，连续四次就装满了。
苏墨也做了一个带上，两手准备，地下二层必有池塘。
用镐子打开洞穴的封口。
【是否通过地洞进入洞穴（起源庇护所）。
洞穴后面的备注，就是标明洞穴的所属庇护所，如果庇护所被摧毁洞穴也不会消失，同时也不会重新编号，「永恒领域」只会继续向后编号。
选择【是】后，一阵眩晕感袭来，再睁眼时，苏墨已经在洞穴内了。
四周漆黑一片，落地点还有一具骨架，这估计是「永恒领域」的恶作剧。
将矿灯帽装备在头上，照亮四周，周围的荧光果也开始照亮四周，虽然只有2米左右，但在这漆黑的地底，有光心里也会舒心不少。
苏墨将周围的荧光果都采摘掉，可这附近都是单果植株，苏墨收获也有限。
荧光果分为单果植株、双果植株和三果植株，顾名思义，同样的采集时间，获得荧光果的数量却不同。
继续前行，洞穴的地形与地面不同，歪七扭八的，苏墨只能一路试错，将地图给探出来。
不，这边是石虾区；不，这边是蝙蝠区。
洞穴入口位于整个洞穴的最中心，苏墨每次向一个方向前进，试错后又要重新回到中心，换一个方向继续试，幸好苏墨有前世经历，否则光试错都要浪费掉一天。
找对了方向，苏墨一直前进，终于在一片遍布蜘蛛网的石笋处发现了洞穴二层的入口——被堵住的洞穴。
苏墨这次的运气属实不太行，在最后一次才找到了正确方向，不幸中的万幸就是二层的入口没有刷新在洞穴蜘蛛的范围中。
这种蜘蛛巢不可移植，因为类似于石笋的结构，如果被镐子破坏掉，就不会再生成蜘蛛了，鉴定过后的名称为石笋蛛巢。
蛛巢内一共有两种蜘蛛，洞穴蜘蛛和喷吐蜘蛛，洞穴蜘蛛比较好对付，当你攻击它时，它会进行缩壳，缩壳之后会提供80%的伤害减免；喷吐蜘蛛，听名字就知道是远程攻击的，在有仇恨时，会向你喷吐一颗坚硬的石头来攻击。

苏墨并不想和这两种蜘蛛打交道，蜘蛛是一家，当其中一只受到攻击时，其余的蜘蛛也会同时产生仇恨，有点类似于虫族了。
这么一想，苏墨越想越觉得像，可能真的是虫族的一支，沉下心，现在不是想这么多的时候。
拿出镐子，苏墨将被堵住的洞穴镐开，这次的材料可得捡着。
【你获得铥矿×1，铥矿碎片×1。
【是否进入洞穴二层】
又是熟悉的眩晕感，等眼前的迷雾消散，苏墨已经进入了洞穴二层，周围已经没有一丝亮光，只有头顶的矿工帽提供着照明。
凭借着地皮上的纹路，苏墨一秒就判断出，还没有处于暴动。
content_en:
Put some unused things in the room on the second floor, and tell Su Ting by the way, let her find some water to wash away the blood stains from the previous battle with the rats. After a day, there is already some smell.
When she came to the second book of science, Su Ting unlocked an empty watering can in [Production - Tools].
[You consume wooden board × 2 and straw rope × 1 to make an empty watering kettle. The empty watering kettle has been unlocked, and the spiritual value is +15.
A small kettle can hold 40 liters of water. You only need to collect it next to a pond or some water source for 1 minute. It can fill 25% of the water in one go, and it can be filled four times in a row.
Su Mo also made one and prepared it with both hands. There must be a pond on the second underground floor.
Use the pickaxe to open the cave's seal.
[Whether to enter the cave (origin shelter) through the underground cave.
The note at the back of the cave indicates the shelter to which the cave belongs. If the shelter is destroyed, the cave will not disappear and will not be renumbered. The "Eternal Realm" will only continue to be numbered backwards.
After selecting [Yes], a feeling of dizziness hit me. When he opened his eyes again, Su Mo was already in the cave.
It was pitch black all around, and there was a skeleton at the landing site. This was probably a prank by the "Eternal Realm".
Put the miner's lamp cap on your head to illuminate the surroundings, and the surrounding fluorescent fruits also began to illuminate the surroundings. Although it was only about 2 meters away, in this dark underground, I felt a lot better when there was light.
Su Mo picked all the fluorescent fruits around, but there were only single-fruit plants nearby, so Su Mo's harvest was limited.
Fluorescent fruits are divided into single-fruit plants, double-fruit plants and triple-fruit plants. As the name suggests, the number of fluorescent fruits obtained is different at the same collection time.
Continuing forward, the cave's terrain was different from the ground. Su Mo could only try and make mistakes along the way to find out the map.
No, this is the rock shrimp area; no, this is the bat area.
The entrance to the cave is located at the center of the entire cave. Every time Su Mo moves forward in one direction, he has to return to the center after trial and error and continue trying in another direction. Fortunately, Su Mo has past life experience, otherwise he would have wasted a whole day just trying and making mistakes.
After finding the right direction, Su Mo kept moving forward and finally found the entrance to the second floor of the cave - the blocked cave - at a stalagmite covered with spider webs.
Su Mo's luck was really not good this time. He found the correct direction only at the last time. Fortunately, the entrance to the second floor was not within the range of the cave spider.
This kind of spider nest cannot be transplanted because the structure is similar to a stalagmite. If it is destroyed by a pickaxe, it will no longer generate spiders. After identification, it is called a stalagmite spider nest.
There are two kinds of spiders in the spider nest, cave spiders and spitting spiders. The cave spider is easier to deal with. When you attack it, it will shrink its shell. After shrinking, it will provide 80% damage reduction;
Su Mo didn't want to deal with these two kinds of spiders. The spiders were one family. When one of them was attacked, the other spiders would also produce hatred at the same time, a bit similar to the Zerg.
Thinking of this, the more Su Mo thought about it, the more it seemed to him that it might really be a branch of the Zerg tribe. He calmed down, now is not the time to think so much.
Taking out the pickaxe, Su Mo opened the blocked cave. This time he had to pick up the materials.
[You get 1 thulium ore and 1 thulium ore fragment.
[Whether to enter the second floor of the cave]
There was the familiar dizziness again. When the fog in front of him dissipated, Su Mo had already entered the second floor of the cave. There was no light around him, and only the miner's hat on his head provided illumination.
Based on the lines on the ground, Su Mo judged in a second that there was no riot yet.
